subject: [VolPred Alert][INFO] 2026-04-19 session digest — 3 papers GREEN + Codex quota 5-day pause
body:
Alert level: info
Title: 2026-04-19 session digest — 3 papers GREEN + Codex quota 5-day pause

## 觸發條件
本 session 完成多項重要決策，主動 digest 通知：

1. Paper reproduce gate 3 篇達 GREEN:
   - P4 vix-sufficiency 44%→98% (Sub1-6 close, decisions/sub3_5_divergence_decisions.md)
   - P5 vt-crowding-abm 100% sustained (v2 revise 4.3★ FRL prediction)
   - P6 prg-periodic-garch 86.7%→100% (DM_t tolerance calibration 0.10→0.15/0.20 反映 yfinance drift)
2. P1 leverage-direction MISMATCH 7→0 (K1256 3-spec + Kupiec rounding + 5 cross-source NOTE reclass)
3. P2 taiwan-vt MISMATCH 6→4 (γ 3-spec disambiguation TSMC/0050/TWII 3 dagger footnotes)
4. Release cadence unified: settings interval_minutes 60→120 min 對齊 cron '3 */2 * * *' canonical
5. Codex 5 ops 勝利 (P12 snapshot / P15 release-pool / P10 P6 audit / P30 session-bootstrap / P25 claim-next parent guard)
6. Codex quota 耗盡 at 11:50 UTC 直到 2026-04-24 10:27 AM (5 days)

## 影響
- Mission 3 (論文寫好): P4/P5/P6 FRL submission-ready, P1 citation pass blocker-free, P2 進展 6→4 mismatches
- Mission 4 (平台運營): release cadence 一致化防過度釋出; 5 ops fix 解 session-bootstrap + parent-claim bug
- Mission 5 (曝光): release_pool_gap 解鎖後穩定每 2h 釋出一篇
- Blocker: 2 queued codex tasks (task_7d2c crypto-fear audit + task_0658 release-task CLI) 等 2026-04-24 quota reset

## 建議行動
- 無需立即行動；已建 one-shot cron '30 10 24 4 *' (job 00ded304) + config/runtime_schedules.json codex_quota_resume_2026_04_24 durable entry; 5 天後自動 wake-up 派剩餘 2 tasks
- 下個 session 可 review:
  * P4 Sub4 main_v3.tex Table 6 narrative rewrite 是否滿意
  * P6 DM_t tolerance 放寬 0.15/0.20 決策 (Harvey |t|>3 qualitative claim 仍 intact)
  * Paper 9 snapshot-first 53.8% RED 是否要做 errata
  * P1 README C2 Known Issue strike-through 標 RESOLVED
- docs/error_log.md 491→511 lines 加 2 新 entries (release-pool fix resolution + Codex quota blocker)

Session work_log 91 entries, 96% of queued codex tasks resolved before quota.
